channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Semi Ojeleye | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Semi Ojeleye from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Rodney Hood, Semi Ojeleye
item.description:
Mirjam Swanson:Ty Lue on the Zoom, on recent acquisitions Rodney Hood and Semi Ojeleye:

“They're pros ... they've been great, and so their opportunity is going to come.”

Tyronn Lue on Rodney Hood, Semi Ojeleye, Feb 27, 2022. Source: Twitter @MirjamSwanson.

item.title: Jay Larranaga on Semi Ojeleye
item.description:
Jay Larranaga on Semi Ojeleye (21 points):

“He made shots tonight. I think he’s still growing in his role and understanding where his shots are going to come from ... He’s doing so many other things (too).”

Jay Larranaga on Semi Ojeleye, Jul 12, 2018. Source: Twitter @celtics.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Semi Ojeleye
item.description:
Stevens on Semi Ojeleye in Game 5:

“Semi probably played more minutes than I would have anticipated, but it was one of those games where even when we couldn’t get shots to fall you felt like your identity was on the other end of the floor in that game, in that night.”

Brad Stevens on Semi Ojeleye, Apr 26, 2018. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.
